blocks.text: LUCENA CITY – Two motorists died in separate road accidents along the Maharlika Highway in Quezon province on Thursday and Friday, police reported. In Sariaya town, a 25-year-old motorcycle rider died after his vehicle crashed into the rear of a parked dump truck along the highway in Barangay Sto. Cristo at around 11 p.m. on Thursday Quezon police said the rider sustained severe injuries and died while undergoing treatment at a local hospital at around 11:50 p.m. READ: Toddler, 2 others dead in Quezon road accidents Police said the parties involved were open to settling the matter amicably outside court.
